status.show.title: Runtime state
status.show.whenToUse: Read state. Pick a section with part.

config.set.title: Set a config value
config.set.whenToUse: Override one config key in the local file; takes effect on the next reload.

config.unset.title: Remove a config override
config.unset.whenToUse: Drop a local override so the key falls back to its default.

bot.pause.title: Pause the persona
bot.pause.whenToUse: Stop the persona from speaking and flush memory to disk.

bot.resume.title: Resume the persona
bot.resume.whenToUse: Restart the persona after a pause; refuses if a data file is invalid.

draw.create.title: Draw a picture
draw.create.whenToUse: Generate one picture. Costs money; a failed picture is still paid. English, {{drawChars}} chars max (cut at last fitting sentence). Order: who and action, setting and light, camera position and direction. Faces: direction and eye target; 'facing the viewer' for selfie or portrait. Every figure: where the limbs inside the frame are, what carries its weight; in a side view, the far limb shows behind the near one. Name contacts the action needs. Camera: side for face plus action toward a target, three-quarters behind for depth; avoid target side (becomes viewer-facing). Keep the camera in profile, not turning the figure for the viewer at the cost of the action. Equipment: type and one layout fact. Ask about place if none obvious; clothes, expression, pose, time you decide. Generic people are not you. Fresh scene; restate setting when continuing.

args.self: True when you appear. Omit appearance. Think first: where, time, clothes, camera, direction (or facing viewer), expression as features not mood (several, pick one new), pose, action. Write all into the scene.

model.set.title: Set a model
model.set.whenToUse: Change the model for one role; takes effect on the next request.

route.set.title: Set a route
route.set.whenToUse: Route a model prefix to specific providers, for one role or all.

route.remove.title: Remove a route
route.remove.whenToUse: Delete a model prefix's provider route.

access.grant.title: Grant access
access.grant.whenToUse: Open an operation or group to a user, a role or everyone.
access.grant.whenNotToUse: Administrative, not grantable to you; you never change rights that reach you.

access.revoke.title: Revoke access
access.revoke.whenToUse: Close an operation or group for a user, a role or everyone.
access.revoke.whenNotToUse: Administrative, not grantable to you; you never change rights that reach you.

alias.add.title: Add an alias
alias.add.whenToUse: Record a nickname for a member.
alias.add.whenNotToUse: Only record names people actually use in conversation.

learning.add.title: Add a lesson
learning.add.whenNotToUse: Only what someone taught you directly.

lore.add.title: Add a lore entry
lore.add.whenToUse: Create or overwrite a lorebook entry.

args.always: true: show even with no key match.

args.section: summary, character, style, relationship, affinity, aliases, interests, details, episodes, raw.

memory.channel.read.title: Read channel notes
memory.channel.read.whenToUse: One channel's notes, or all channels.

memory.forget.title: Forget a member
memory.forget.whenToUse: Delete a member's profile, private memory, versions and record entries; a vault copy is saved first.

memory.wipe.title: Wipe all memory
memory.wipe.whenToUse: Delete every stored profile, channel note, habit, lore entry and private memory for the whole server; a vault copy is saved first.

memory.journal.read.title: Read journal
memory.journal.read.whenToUse: Day's records or a turn behind your message.

args.kind: turn, action, memory, system, answer, inner, all.

memory.restore.title: Restore from archive
memory.restore.whenToUse: Put an archived item back into active memory, replacing what is stored at its position.

memory.private.forget.title: Forget private memory
memory.private.forget.whenToUse: Delete a member's private DM memory; the public profile stays.

memory.private.purge.title: Purge private chat
memory.private.purge.whenToUse: Delete a member's private memory and bulk-delete your DM messages to them.
memory.private.purge.whenNotToUse: Destructive, irreversible for the messages, not grantable to you.

message.create.title: Post a message
message.create.whenToUse: For another channel, errand file, or media repost. <msg> covers this channel. One GIF, file, or repost per post; they do not combine.

args.media: Your #N or link; reposts its attachment.

message.delete.title: Delete your message
message.delete.whenToUse: Remove your message. #N, link, or "last"; channel required with "last".

task.run.title: Hand off an errand
task.run.whenToUse: Background job; result later. Costs money. web: internet, pages, files; server: this machine. Files for message.create. Several at once, each agent one at a time. Form the full goal first. Agent sees only the goal.
task.run.whenNotToUse: Not for what you can answer; daily limits.

args.goal: What to do. Agent sees only this.

task.status.title: Check an errand
task.status.whenToUse: Errand state by id or open ones.

task.read.title: Read an errand's result
task.read.whenToUse: Full result in pages. Marks the errand as read.

task.resolve.title: Close a finished errand
task.resolve.whenNotToUse: Not needed once you report its result.

task.cancel.title: Cancel an errand
task.cancel.whenNotToUse: Only the requester or the owner.

web.search.title: Search the web
web.search.whenToUse: Look up a fact. Returns in this turn.

web.read.title: Read a web page
web.read.whenToUse: Read one page by link. Same turn.

media.look.title: Look more closely
media.look.whenToUse: Closer look at a picture, GIF or video in the chat. Watches a video by link before you share or talk about it. Same turn.
media.look.whenNotToUse: Not when the first look answers.

args.url: A video link from a supported site, instead of a message.
args.item: Which attachment of the message (1 to 20).
args.question: What to look for.

media.find.title: Find a GIF
media.find.whenToUse: Search GIF library. Handles for <gif> or message.create.

memory.search.title: Search this server's messages
memory.search.whenToUse: Find what was said. Quoted sample with time and author.

conversation.read.title: Read a channel
conversation.read.whenToUse: Any channel. around (#N), since (delay, time, date-time), last (default 20, max 60). Returns #N lines.

args.before: With around: count before (default 10). Alone: #N or link, read last lines before it.
args.after: With around: count after (default 10). Alone: #N or link, read last lines after it.

intent.set.title: Set an intention
intent.set.whenToUse: Schedule something for later; must be called in this turn. Agreement alone creates nothing. Tell people only after the call succeeds.
intent.set.whenNotToUse: Not for what you can do directly in this turn. To change an existing one: intent.update.

args.due: Delay (30m; 0m: right away), date, clock (21:00), weekday+time (mon 20:00).
args.deadline: Wait time. Without task, links this turn's errand.
args.attend: Listen to a place; wakes on new lines. due/every ignored.
args.expires: When it lapses; time like due.
args.people: With attend: only these people's lines wake you.

intent.update.title: Update an intention
intent.update.whenToUse: Change an intention. done: one occurrence. dropped+reason: let go. Accept candidate: state pending. intent.cancel ends repeating.
intent.update.whenNotToUse: Reject a candidate or an intention: intent.cancel.

args.id: Intention id, or as bare text.
args.expires: When it lapses; time like due.

intent.cancel.title: Cancel an intention
intent.cancel.whenToUse: Drop one you reject or no longer need. Rejects a proposed candidate.

inner.stop.title: Stop the inner life
inner.stop.whenToUse: Stop the persona's own wake-ups and drop the queued ones.

inner.start.title: Start the inner life
inner.start.whenToUse: Let the persona's own wake-ups run again after a stop.

inner.status.title: Inner life status
inner.status.whenToUse: Show whether the persona's own wake-ups run, what is queued and what is left of their caps.

intent.list.title: List intentions
intent.list.whenToUse: Open intentions with states and times.

places.list.title: See the server's places
places.list.whenToUse: Counts, access, listening. To listen: intent.set with attend.
places.list.whenNotToUse: For what was said: chat or memory.search.

skills.describe.title: Describe a skill
skills.describe.whenToUse: Full description, or family for all in it. Use when unsure about arguments.
